content:
[Thinking]
**Naming paradoxical groups**

I’m brainstorming a catchy two-word name for a group that encompasses paradoxes. “Paradoxical Mathecreamers” pops up, highlighting the mix of ice cream love and allergy issues, but it feels a bit clunky. Then there’s “Ironic Analysts,” which has a nice ring to it. I wonder if “Contradiction Connoisseurs” fits better since it captures both math and ice cream contradictions while keeping it concise. I’ll keep tweaking until I find the perfect name!
[/Thinking]

Contradiction Connoisseurs
